segments.text: Last year, my best friend asked if she could borrow some money.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker mentions that their closest friend asked to borrow money last year.
segments.turkishExplanation: Geçen yıl en yakın arkadaşım benden biraz borç para istedi.

segments.text: I lent it to her immediately because that's what friends do.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker gave the money right away, believing that helping each other is what friends do.
segments.turkishExplanation: Arkadaşlar böyle yapar diyerek parayı ona hemen borç verdim.

segments.text: She told me she would pay me back in a month.
segments.englishExplanation: The friend promised to return the money within a month.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bana borcunu bir ay içinde geri ödeyeceğini söyledi.

segments.text: Two months later, she hadn't said anything about it.
segments.englishExplanation: Two months went by without the friend mentioning the money at all.
segments.turkishExplanation: İki ay geçmesine rağmen bu konuda hiçbir şey söylememişti.

segments.text: I didn't want to ruin our friendship so I said nothing too.
segments.englishExplanation: To avoid damaging their relationship, the speaker decided to stay silent as well.
segments.turkishExplanation: Arkadaşlığımızı bozmak istemediğim için ben de bir şey söylemedim.

segments.text: Finally, I told her how I felt.
segments.englishExplanation: Eventually, the speaker expressed their true feelings about the situation.

segments.text: She was embarrassed and paid me back the next week. We're still close.
segments.englishExplanation: The friend felt ashamed, returned the money the following week, and they remain good friends.
segments.turkishExplanation: Mahcup oldu ve ertesi hafta bana parayı geri ödedi. Hâlâ yakınız.

segments.text: You can lend money to a friend, but remember to lend them honesty too.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker concludes with advice that being open and honest is as important as lending money.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bir arkadaşına borç verebilirsin ama ona dürüst davranmayı da unutma.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To return money that you previously borrowed from someone.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Birinden alınan borç parayı geri ödemek.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I will pay you back as soon as I get my salary.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Maaşımı alır almaz sana olan borcumu geri ödeyeceğim.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to remind someone not to forget an intended action in the future.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Gelecekte yapılması gereken bir eylemi unutmamayı hatırlatmak için kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Remember to lock the door before leaving.

quiz.question: In segment 8, what advice does the speaker give alongside lending money to a friend?

options.text: Be open and honest with them about how you feel.
Always demand a strict repayment deadline in advance.
Avoid discussing money issues to keep the peace.
Ask another mutual friend to mediate the conversation.
